cvars.help: Turn on to enable caching

cvars.help: Skip invalidation of cached pages when geometry moves for debugging purposes. This will create obvious visual artifacts when disabled.

cvars.help: Forces the clipmap to always invalidate, useful to emulate a moving sun to avoid misrepresenting cache performance.

cvars.help: The maximum number of frames to allow lights (and their associated pages) that aren't present in the current frame to live in the cache.\n

cvars.help: First level of the virtual clipmap. Lower values allow higher resolution shadows closer to the camera, but may increase page count.

cvars.name: r.Shadow.Virtual.Clipmap.LastCoarseLevel
cvars.help: Last level of the clipmap to mark coarse pages for. Higher values provide dense clipmap data for a longer radius but increase total page counts.

cvars.name: r.Shadow.Virtual.Clipmap.LastLevel
cvars.help: Last level of the virtual clipmap. Indirectly determines radius the clipmap can cover. Each extra level doubles the maximum range, but may increase page count.

cvars.help: If greater than zero, clamps the camera viewport dimensions used to adjust the clipmap resolution.\n

cvars.name: r.Shadow.Virtual.CoarsePagePixelThresholdDynamicNanite
cvars.help: If a dynamic Nanite instance has a smaller estimated pixel footprint than this value, it should not be drawn into a coarse page. Higher values cull away more instances.\n

cvars.name: r.Shadow.Virtual.CoarsePagePixelThresholdStatic
cvars.help: If a static (non-nanite) instance has a smaller estimated pixel footprint than this value, it should not be drawn into a coarse page. Higher values cull away more instances.\n

cvars.name: r.Shadow.Virtual.CullBackfacingPixels
cvars.help: When enabled does not generate shadow data for pixels that are backfacing to the light.

cvars.help: Range in froxel tiles from the mouse cursor which to draw debug froxels in.

cvars.help: Render the froxels using shaderprint (which needs to be enabled) r.ShaderPrint.MaxLine also needs to be set to a high value as this produces many lines.

cvars.help: Skip the merging of the static VSM cache into the dynamic one. This will create obvious visual artifacts when disabled.

Control whether distant light mode is enabled for local lights.
0 == Off, 
1 == On (default), 
2 == Force All.

cvars.help: Controls the behavior of VSM resources being dynamically allocated/deallocated based on whether VSM shadows are present:\n

cvars.help: When enabled, a separate HZB is built for dynamic cached pages.\n

cvars.name: r.Shadow.Virtual.DynamicRes.LoadBudget
cvars.help: Scale LOD bias based on an estimate of the ShadowDepths load. Lower value means more aggressive resolution downscaling.\n

cvars.name: r.Shadow.Virtual.DynamicRes.MaxComputeResolutionLodBiasDirectional
cvars.help: As compute-time cost limits are approached, VSM resolution ramps down by biasing the LOD up.\n

cvars.name: r.Shadow.Virtual.DynamicRes.MaxComputeResolutionLodBiasLocal
cvars.help: As compute-time cost limits are approached, VSM resolution ramps down by biasing the LOD up.\n

cvars.help: If allocation exceeds this factor of total page pool capacity, shadow resolution will be biased downwards. 0 = disabled

cvars.name: r.Shadow.Virtual.DynamicRes.MaxResolutionLodBias
cvars.help: As memory or compute-time cost limits are approached, VSM resolution ramps down by biasing the LOD up, similar to 'ResolutionLodBiasDirectional'.\n

cvars.name: r.Shadow.Virtual.DynamicRes.PerVSMBiasHistoryWeight
cvars.help: Smoothen out the per-VSM LOD bias over time. Value between 0 and 1.

cvars.name: r.Shadow.Virtual.DynamicRes.TimeBudgetMs
cvars.help: Frame's time budget for VSM ShadowDepths in milliseconds. Non-Nanite not included.\n

cvars.name: r.Shadow.Virtual.Enable
cvars.help: Enable Virtual Shadow Maps. Renders geometry into virtualized shadow depth maps for shadowing.\n

cvars.name: r.Shadow.Virtual.ForceFullHZBUpdate
cvars.help: Forces full HZB update every frame rather than just dirty pages.\n

cvars.name: r.Shadow.Virtual.ForceFullPageClears
cvars.help: Always clear physical pages, even when nothing has been written to them.

cvars.name: r.Shadow.Virtual.ForcePerLightShadowMaskClear
cvars.help: For debugging purposes. When enabled, the shadow mask texture is cleared before the projection pass writes to it. Projection pass writes all relevant pixels, so clearing should be unnecessary.

cvars.name: r.Shadow.Virtual.MarkCoarsePagesDirectional
cvars.help: Marks coarse pages in local light virtual shadow maps so that low resolution data is available everywhere.\n

cvars.name: r.Shadow.Virtual.MarkCoarsePagesLocal
cvars.help: Marks coarse pages in local light virtual shadow maps so that low resolution data is available everywhere.\n

cvars.name: r.Shadow.Virtual.MarkPagesUsingFroxels
cvars.help: Experimental: If enabled the virtual shadow map pages are marked using froxels that are generated during HZB build.\n

cvars.name: r.Shadow.Virtual.MarkPixelPages
cvars.help: Marks pages in virtual shadow maps based on depth buffer pixels. Ability to disable is primarily for profiling and debugging.

cvars.name: r.Shadow.Virtual.MarkPixelPagesMipModeLocal
cvars.help: When enabled, this uses a subset of mips to reduce instance duplication in VSMs. Will result in better performance but a harsher falloff on mip transitions.\n

cvars.help: Determine which pixels are out of focus, and request a lower VSM resolution in those areas.\n

cvars.name: r.Shadow.Virtual.MaxDistantUpdatePerFrame
cvars.help: Maximum number of distant lights to update each frame. Invalidated lights that were missed may be updated in a later frame (round-robin).

cvars.name: r.Shadow.Virtual.MaxPhysicalPages
cvars.help: Maximum number of physical pages in the pool.\n

cvars.name: r.Shadow.Virtual.Nanite.AllowMultipassViews
cvars.help: When enabled, allows multiple Nanite passes if the view count might exceed Nanite limits.\n

cvars.name: r.Shadow.Virtual.Nanite.AllowTessellationDirectional
cvars.help: When enabled, allows Nanite Tessellation to be rendered in directional light shadows.

cvars.name: r.Shadow.Virtual.Nanite.AllowTessellationLocal
cvars.help: When enabled, allows Nanite Tessellation to be rendered in local light shadows.

cvars.name: r.Shadow.Virtual.Nanite.MaterialVisibility
cvars.help: Enable Nanite CPU-side visibility filtering of draw commands, depends on r.Nanite.MaterialVisibility being enabled.

cvars.help: Include non-Nanite geometry in coarse pages.

cvars.help: If enabled (default) the r.Shadow.RadiusThreshold cvar is also used for uncached virtual shadow maps to cull small non-nanite instances.

cvars.name: r.Shadow.Virtual.NormalBias

cvars.help: Projects all local light virtual shadow maps in a single pass for better performance.

cvars.help: Maximum lights per pixel that get full filtering when using one pass projection and clustered shading.

cvars.name: r.Shadow.Virtual.PageDilationBorderSizeLocal
cvars.help: If a screen pixel falls within this fraction of a page border for local lights, the adacent page will also be mapped.

cvars.help: During page marking, instead of testing every screen pixel, test every Nth pixel.\n

cvars.name: r.Shadow.Virtual.PageMarkingPixelStrideY
cvars.help: Same as PageMarkingPixelStrideX, but on the vertical axis of the screen.

cvars.name: r.Shadow.Virtual.ResolutionLodBiasLocalMoving
cvars.help: Bias applied to LOD calculations for local lights that are moving. -1.0 doubles resolution, 1.0 halves it and so on.\n

cvars.help: Max angle (in radians) a ray is allowed to span from the light's perspective for local lights.

cvars.help: Ray count for shadow map tracing of directional lights. 0 = disabled.

cvars.name: r.Shadow.Virtual.SMRT.RayCountLocal
cvars.help: Ray count for shadow map tracing of local lights. 0 = disabled.

cvars.name: r.Shadow.Virtual.SMRT.RayLengthScaleDirectional
cvars.help: Length of ray to shoot for directional lights, scaled by distance to camera.

cvars.name: r.Shadow.Virtual.SMRT.SamplesPerRayHair

cvars.help: Shadow map samples per ray for local lights

cvars.name: r.Shadow.Virtual.SMRT.TexelDitherScaleLocal
cvars.help: Applies a dither to the shadow map ray casts for local lights to help hide aliasing due to insufficient shadow resolution.\n

cvars.name: r.Shadow.Virtual.ScreenRayLength
cvars.help: Length of the screen space shadow trace away from receiver surface (smart shadow bias) before the VSM / SMRT lookup.

cvars.name: r.Shadow.Virtual.Stats.Sections

cvars.name: r.Shadow.Virtual.Stats.Visible
cvars.help: Render VSM Stats to screen

cvars.help: Controls the quality of TSR's built-in spatial anti-aliasing technology when the history needs to be rejected.

cvars.name: r.TSR.ReprojectionField
cvars.help: Enables TSR's reprojection field for higher reprojection vector upscale and dilate quality (Enabled by default on high, epic and cinematic anti-aliasing quality).\n

cvars.name: r.TSR.ReprojectionField.AntiAliasPixelSpeed
cvars.help: Defines the output pixel velocity at which point the dilation should be spatial anti-aliased based of the depth buffer

cvars.name: r.TSR.Resurrection
cvars.help: Allows TSR to resurrect previously discarded details from many frames ago.\n

cvars.name: r.TSR.Resurrection.PersistentFrameCount
cvars.help: Configures the number of persistent frame to record in history for futur history resurrection.

cvars.name: r.TSR.Resurrection.PersistentFrameInterval
cvars.help: Configures in number of frames how often persistent frame should be recorded in history for futur history resurrection.

cvars.name: r.TSR.ShadingRejection.ExposureOffset
cvars.help: The shading rejection needs to have a representative idea how bright a linear color pixel ends up displayed to the user.

cvars.name: r.TSR.ShadingRejection.Flickering
cvars.help: Instability in TSR output 99% of the time coming from instability of the shading rejection, for different reasons:\n

cvars.name: r.TSR.ShadingRejection.Flickering.AdjustToFrameRate
cvars.help: Whether r.TSR.ShadingRejection.Flickering.Period settings should adjust to frame rate when below r.TSR.ShadingRejection.Flickering.FrameRateCap.

cvars.name: r.TSR.ShadingRejection.Flickering.FrameRateCap
cvars.help: Framerate cap in hertz at which point there is automatic adjustment of r.TSR.ShadingRejection.Flickering.Period when the rendering frame rate is lower.

cvars.name: r.TSR.ShadingRejection.Flickering.MaxParallaxVelocity
cvars.help: Some material might for instance might do something like parallax occlusion mapping such as CitySample's buildings' window's interiors.

cvars.name: r.TSR.ShadingRejection.Flickering.Period
cvars.help: Periode in frames in which luma oscilations at equal or greater frequency is considered flickering and should ghost to stabilize the image

cvars.name: r.TSR.ShadingRejection.Mode
cvars.help: 0: More responsiveness and less ghosting but tends to have more blocky artifacts.\n

cvars.name: r.TSR.ShadingRejection.SampleCount
cvars.help: Maximum number of sample in each output pixel of the history after total shading rejection.\n

cvars.name: r.TSR.ShadingRejection.TileOverscan
cvars.help: The shading rejection run a network of convolutions on the GPU all in single 32x32 without roundtrip to main video memory.

cvars.name: r.TSR.Support.LensDistortion
cvars.help: Whether to compile lens distortion support in TSR's shaders

cvars.name: r.TSR.ThinGeometryDetection
cvars.help: Define if we should perform another pass to detect thin geometries (sub-pixel in frame buffer) either due to sampling algorithm before TSR or the geometry being too thin (Default = 0).

cvars.name: r.TSR.ThinGeometryDetection.AntiFlickering
cvars.help: Thin geometry detection can sometimes fail. Whether the anti-flickering logic considers the thin geometry detection pass.

cvars.name: r.TSR.ThinGeometryDetection.Coverage.MaxRelaxationWeight
cvars.help: The max history clamping box relaxation weight due to thin geometry detection (0 to 1)

cvars.name: r.TSR.ThinGeometryDetection.Coverage.MinKeepLineContrast
cvars.help: The minimum luminance contrast needed to keep a detected intensity line after normalization

cvars.name: r.TSR.ThinGeometryDetection.Coverage.ShadingRange
cvars.help: The shading model range regarded as thin geometry and accumulate the coverage.\n

cvars.name: r.TSR.ThinGeometryDetection.ErrorMultiplier
cvars.help: Scales the depth-based edge detection threshold. Higher values require larger depth discontinuities to classify as thin geometry edges.\n

cvars.name: r.TSR.ThinGeometryDetection.HighContrastLineFadeRate
cvars.help: How quickly reprojected high contrast line markers fade out outside validated thin geometry regions. 0=never, 1=instant (default=0.1).

cvars.name: r.TSR.ThinGeometryDetection.HighContrastLineFadeRateInsideRegion
cvars.help: How quickly reprojected high contrast line markers fade out inside validated thin geometry regions. 0=never, 1=instant (default=0.03).

cvars.name: r.TSR.ThinGeometryDetection.HighContrastLineWeight
cvars.help: Relaxation weight applied to detected high contrast lines when no cluster-based relaxation is active.

cvars.name: r.TSR.ThinGeometryDetection.RejectTranslucency
cvars.help: Translucency ratio threshold above which all thin geometry detection is rejected for a pixel in the next frame (0 to disable).

cvars.name: r.TSR.ThinGeometryDetection.WeightRelaxation
cvars.help: Adaptively trim the history relaxation to avoid ghosting.

cvars.name: r.TSR.Velocity.WeightClampingPixelSpeed
cvars.help: Defines the output pixel velocity at which the the high frequencies of the history get's their contributing weight clamped.

cvars.name: r.TSR.Velocity.WeightClampingSampleCount
cvars.help: Number of sample to count to in history pixel to clamp history to when output pixel velocity reach r.TSR.Velocity.WeightClampingPixelSpeed.

cvars.name: r.TSR.Visualize
cvars.help: Selects the TSR internal visualization mode.\n

cvars.name: r.TSR.WaveOps
cvars.help: Whether to use wave ops in the shading rejection heuristics to speeds up convolutions.\n

cvars.name: r.TSR.WaveSize
cvars.help: Overrides the WaveSize to use.\n
